question:

solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e9fca0479973393a1d929ab87105351af84b1060cd79f10c0ab98bd7607d80c.png] 

4) For " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6f0cbf7fb6c9d34bdfc78ceb5170692b030d7e95f20ca210c9706821d72032f.png] " element → Remains constant starting from the 4th box

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bf9f4c629604a7fd1c2d3d7915971330707f429052096f5003be9085f66d27a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (3)".
